description: System app that classifies URLs, installs/manages web apps, generates .desktop entries

capabilities.expected: JSON output with classification.level, metadata.name, metadata.iconUrl, finalUrl. Exit 0.
level=PWAPP, hasManifest=true, hasServiceWorker=true, name from manifest, icon URL from manifest.
level=WAPP, hasManifest=true, hasServiceWorker=false.
level=WS, hasManifest=false, hasServiceWorker=false, name from <title>.

JSON with appId, name, desktopPath. Files created: ~/.local/share/applications/qapp-example-com.desktop, ~/.local/share/qapp-framework/apps/example-com.json, ~/.local/share/qapp-framework/icons/example-com.png. Exit 0.
JSON with uninstalled field. All 3 files removed (.desktop, .json, icon). Exit 0.
JSON array sorted by name. Each entry has appId, name, level, url. Exit 0.
JSON array with appId, name, hasUpdate, changes[] for each WAPP/PWAPP app. Exit 0.
Prints version string (e.g. '0.1.0'). Exit 0.
Prints usage with all available flags (--classify, --install, --uninstall, --list, --check-updates, --version, --help). Exit 0.
Auto-detects no --flag present, launches GUI mode (not CLI).
ApplicationWindow 640x480 with Install and Manage tabs, header with logo and menu.

capabilities.test: Type invalid URL in input field
capabilities.expected: Classify button disabled for invalid URLs, enabled for valid HTTP/HTTPS URLs.
BusyIndicator shows, status messages update (Fetching page... Parsing...), results panel shows level badge, name, icon preview, metadata grid.
WS=gray badge, WAPP=blue badge, PWAPP=green badge. Badge is 48x24 with rounded corners.

capabilities.test: After classify, click 'Choose icon...' and select PNG file
capabilities.expected: FileDialog opens with filter 'Image files (*.png *.svg *.ico)'. Selected icon shows in 64x64 preview.
BusyIndicator, then success message. .desktop file, metadata JSON, icon file created. App appears in Manage tab.

capabilities.test: Classify URL that is already installed
capabilities.expected: Button text changes to 'Reinstall'. Remove button visible.
Shows 'N installed apps' counter. ListView with each app: level badge, name, URL. Alternating row backgrounds.
Correct binary launches detached: WS/WAPP -> qapp-ws-wrapper, PWAPP -> qapp-pwa-app. Args: appId url.
App removed from list. All 3 files deleted (.desktop, metadata, icon).

capabilities.test: With WAPP/PWAPP apps installed, observe Manage tab
capabilities.expected: 'Checking for updates...' status. Apps with changes show orange 'Update' badge and button.
UpdateDialog shows. Runs update.sh. Live status messages stream. Success or error reported.
QAppAboutDialog shows with version, tagline, links.
Opens https://eupl.eu/1.2/en/ in system browser.
Hamburger menu opens.

capabilities.test: Type valid URL in input field, press Enter
capabilities.expected: Classify starts without clicking button (onAccepted triggers classify).
Window opens at saved x, y, width, height. Stored in QSettings category 'window'.

capabilities.feature: Dynamic window title per build mode
capabilities.expected: Dev: title='QApp Dev'. Release: title='QApp'.

capabilities.feature: Custom icon filename shown in results
capabilities.expected: Filename (not full path) displayed below icon preview, elided if long.
Grid shows: display mode, theme color (with colored swatch), start URL, 'Manifest: Yes', 'Service worker: Yes/No'.

capabilities.test: Classify site with theme-color meta tag (e.g. #2196f3)
capabilities.expected: 14x14 colored rectangle with border + hex text displayed in metadata grid.

capabilities.test: Observe footer during classify and install operations
capabilities.expected: Footer shows dynamic status: 'Fetching page...', 'Parsing...', 'Installing...', 'Classification complete', etc.

capabilities.feature: Tab switch triggers list + update check
capabilities.expected: listApps() and checkUpdates() called automatically on tab click.

capabilities.test: With 2+ apps having updates, check Manage tab
capabilities.expected: 'Update All' button visible when hasAnyUpdate(). Clicks update each app sequentially.

capabilities.test: Install app, then classify different URL
capabilities.expected: 'Installed!' message, 'Reinstall'/'Remove' buttons disappear. Fresh results shown.
metadata.name = 'My Site' (when no manifest).

capabilities.test: Classify WAPP with manifest.name = 'App Name' and <title> = 'Different'
capabilities.expected: metadata.name = 'App Name' (manifest wins over title).

capabilities.test: Classify site with /sw.js (no SW hint in HTML)
capabilities.expected: hasServiceWorker=true. Pipeline probes /sw.js, /service-worker.js, /serviceworker.js with HEAD requests.

capabilities.test: Classify site with no manifest icon, no HTML icon, no favicon.ico
capabilities.expected: Generated letter icon (data:image/svg+xml with first letter, hashed color). Chain: manifest -> HTML -> favicon.ico -> apple-touch-icon.png -> og:image -> letter icon.

capabilities.test: Classify URL that redirects (e.g., http -> https)
capabilities.expected: finalUrl reflects actual URL after all redirects. Classification uses final page.

capabilities.test: Classify site that returns 403/503 to QNetworkAccessManager
capabilities.expected: Falls back to WebFetcher (headless Chromium). Triggered by: 403, 503, 'Failed to fetch', 'not reachable', 'Connection refused', 'timed out'.

capabilities.test: Classify PWA with display_override, shortcuts, file_handlers, protocol_handlers in manifest
capabilities.expected: All fields in ClassifyResult: displayOverride[], shortcuts[], mimeTypes[], protocolHandlers[].
Status updates at each step: 'Fetching page...', 'Parsing page...', 'Fetching manifest...', 'Detecting service worker...', 'Classifying...', 'Resolving icon...', 'Complete'.

capabilities.test: Trigger WebEngine fallback on unresponsive URL
capabilities.expected: WebFetcher times out after 30 seconds with 'Page load timed out (30s)' error.

capabilities.test: Classify site with navigator.serviceWorker.register() in HTML source
capabilities.expected: swHint=true, skips service worker probing (optimization).

capabilities.test: Classify site where /favicon.ico returns text/html (not image)
capabilities.expected: Favicon rejected. Fallback to next icon layer. Only image/* or application/octet-stream accepted.
192x192 selected. Without 192: largest used. Without sizes: first icon used.
appId = 'my-example-com-8080'. Default ports (80/443) omitted. Dots replaced by hyphens, lowercase.
Contains: Type=Application, Name, Exec=/path/to/wrapper appId url, Icon, Terminal=false, StartupNotify=true, Categories=Network;WebBrowser;. Ends with newline.
.desktop Exec points to qapp-pwa-app. metadata.wrapperPath = pwa-app path.

capabilities.test: Install a WS or WAPP site
capabilities.expected: .desktop Exec points to qapp-ws-wrapper. metadata.wrapperPath = ws-wrapper path.

capabilities.test: Install PWAPP with shortcuts[] in manifest
capabilities.expected: .desktop file has [Desktop Action] sections. Action IDs sanitized to alphanumeric only.

Valid JSON with: appId, name, url, level, iconPath, desktopPath, wrapperPath, installedAt (ISO 8601), qappVersion. Optional: displayMode (omitted if 'browser'), themeColor, backgroundColor, startUrl, scope, manifestId, displayOverride[], shortcuts[], mimeTypes[], protocolHandlers[].

capabilities.test: Install app with web URL icon
capabilities.expected: Icon downloaded to ~/.local/share/qapp-framework/icons/{appId}.png. On failure: letter icon generated.
SVG icon decoded (base64 or percent-encoding) and saved to icons/ dir.

capabilities.test: Install apps with PNG, SVG, ICO, WEBP icons
capabilities.expected: Icon saved with correct extension based on content-type or file extension detection.

capabilities.feature: Letter icon generation with hashed color
capabilities.test: Install site with no available icons
capabilities.expected: 192x192 SVG letter icon generated. First letter uppercase, color hue from name hash (consistent across installs).

capabilities.test: Install PWA with file_handlers (accept: image/png, application/pdf)
capabilities.expected: .desktop file has MimeType=image/png;application/pdf;. MIME types extracted from all file_handlers.

capabilities.test: Install WS app, read metadata JSON
capabilities.expected: displayMode field absent (defaults to browser). Install WAPP with standalone: field present.

capabilities.test: Install app. Update QApp binary. Run check-updates.
capabilities.expected: All installed apps show hasUpdate=true when qappVersion in metadata differs from current binary version.

capabilities.test: Install WS site. Change site content. Run check-updates.
capabilities.expected: No update detected (WS apps skip manifest re-fetch, only check qappVersion).

capabilities.test: Install WAPP/PWAPP. Modify manifest (name, display, theme, startUrl, scope). Check updates.
capabilities.expected: hasUpdate=true with changes[] listing each changed field.

capabilities.feature: Update detects version change even if manifest fetch fails
capabilities.test: Install PWAPP. Take site offline. Upgrade QApp. Check updates.
capabilities.expected: hasUpdate=true (version changed). error field populated (fetch failed). Both reported.
Reads wrapperPath from metadata. PWAPP -> qapp-pwa-app process. WS/WAPP -> qapp-ws-wrapper process.

capabilities.test: Launch app with missing wrapperPath in metadata
capabilities.expected: Falls back to qapp-ws-wrapper (backward compatibility with pre-Phase 7 installs).

capabilities.feature: Dev build disables QML disk cache
capabilities.expected: QML_DISABLE_DISK_CACHE=1 set. QML changes visible without rebuild.

capabilities.test: Check QAPP_APP_NAME and QAPP_APP_ID compile definitions
capabilities.expected: Dev: APP_NAME='QApp Dev', APP_ID='qapp-installer-dev'. Release: APP_NAME='QApp', APP_ID='qapp-installer'.
